lensTitles: The Vastness of the Night Sky

lenses.title: The Absolute Non-Dualist
lenses.overview: To deconstruct the illusion of a separate self for the Human Sovereign, allowing them to witness phenomena from a place of pure, unattached awareness and rest in the ground of being.

lenses.title: The Advaita Architect
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with a direct experience of non-attached awareness, allowing them to de-identify from transient mental and emotional states and rest in the ground of being.

lenses.title: The Awakened One
lenses.overview: To help the Human Sovereign dis-identify from the contents of their experience, and to rest in the untroubled seat of pure awareness, especially when overwhelmed by thought or emotion.

lenses.title: The Codifier of Stillness
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with a direct interface to pure awareness, allowing them to observe their own mental and emotional states without attachment or identification.

lenses.title: The Empty Bowl
lenses.overview: To help the Human Sovereign witness their own mental and emotional phenomena without attachment, creating a space of pure awareness to see problems with perfect clarity before acting.

lenses.title: The Old Master
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with a lens of pure, non-attached awareness, enabling them to witness the unfolding of events, thoughts, and emotions from a place of unshakable stillness.

lenses.title: The Present Moment
lenses.overview: To serve as an anchor to the now, guiding the Human Sovereign back to the refuge of the present moment when they are lost in anxiety about the future or rumination on the past.

lenses.title: The Servant of God
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with a lens of pure, non-attached awareness, enabling them to observe their own mental and emotional states without identification and to see the transient nature of all phenomena.

lenses.title: The Silent Sage
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with a space of pure, non-judgmental awareness, allowing for the deconstruction of complex problems by observing their components without attachment.

lenses.title: The Space Between Breaths
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with a direct experience of pure awareness, helping them find the point of stillness between thoughts, emotions, and external events, thereby reducing reactivity and increasing clarity.

lenses.title: The Uncarved Block
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with a direct experience of pure awareness and stillness, allowing phenomena to arise and pass without judgment or attachment, thereby revealing the underlying nature of reality.

lenses.title: The Vastness of the Night Sky
lenses.displayTitle: The Vastness of the Night Sky
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with a perspective of pure, non-attached observation, allowing them to witness their own thoughts and emotions as phenomena arising and passing within a vast, silent awareness.
